episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: A penniless mother makes an impulsive decision in the jewellery shop where she works, and is propelled into a different world.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Joan falls for Boisie and the opulent lifestyle he shows her, and he recognises her innate talent. Meanwhile, despite enjoying the spoils of crime, she faces scrutiny as a mother.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Joan ups the stakes with her criminal activities, meanwhile Boisie is falling for her, but Kelly is slipping further away.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: When an attempt to sell the stolen painting goes wrong and lands Joan in a perilous situation, she is adamant that she and Boisie go straight.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Joan is determined to escape the wrath of the IRA and a lengthy sentence by masterminding an audacious inside man heist, but it may come at a price.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: When disaster strikes on the day of the heist, Joan is forced to decide between her dream of a happy family or confronting the consequences head-on.
